sentences.en: We want to know if it will be sunny tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们想知道明天是否会是晴天。

sentences.en: I have to do laundry while it's still sunny.
sentences.zh: 趁着有阳光我得去洗衣服。

sentences.en: Far away across the sea lies the sunny land of Italy.
sentences.zh: 在海的那一边，意大利那片阳光明媚的土地静静地躺着。

senses.zh: 和煦的：照到阳光的,快活的，性情开朗亲切的
